title: Bifunctorial derived tensor comparison for exact open restriction
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and U any open. Give module sheaves on X, every over-site of X, and U derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] in a common localization universe. Let R be the derived functor of exact over-site restriction followed by the canonical over equivalence [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits], and use the shared derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. There exists a family of isomorphisms t(K,L): R(K tensor L) ≅ R(K) tensor R(L), natural simultaneously in both derived inputs: R(a tensor b); t(Kprime,Lprime) = t(K,L); (R(a) tensor R(b)). There are no boundedness or quasi-coherence assumptions.

proof.text: Identify module tensor pullback for the open inclusion with restriction, using uniqueness of module pullback adjunctions and Modules.overFunctorEquiv. Exactness transfers across this natural isomorphism. The localization factorization exhibits the exact mapDerivedCategory as a left derived functor; uniqueness of left derived functors identifies it with recorded derivedPullback. Derive the module natural isomorphism to identify the latter with R.

Take the stated canonical monoidal model of derived pullback and transport its monoidal structure to R. Its inverse tensorators give t; the oplax tensorator naturality theorem gives the displayed square for all a and b.
